caveat: reviewer visual audit, not field-verified. One reviewer, t0|t1|mask crops at 2x, tile-level leads (top 15 by area; sone has only 10 leads under the rules). 'real' = looks like the claimed land-cover change; not confirmed as illegal.

notes.sone: real: rectangular water pit on a sand bar, absent/not water at t0. unsure: irregular blob or enlargement of an existing pit field. wrong: tiny slivers, farm/urban ponds, waterline or field edges. Pits already water at t0 inside the pit field are not new.
notes.hasdeo: real: forest to bare/mine overburden, visible in t0|t1. unsure: edge slivers/shadow/road. wrong: reservoir drawdown shoreline, village fields.
